Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically focuses on the identification of the CD137 signalosome via co-immunoprecipitation. While the broader paper uses SMAC mimetics and genetic perturbations (DN variants), the MS data described in the methods and results (Fig 1) is derived from the stimulation of T cells with CD137L/anti-CD3 and the subsequent pull-down with anti-CD137 mAb. Therefore, the primary biological variable for the MS dataset is ligand-mediated stimulation. Mapping is kept at the parent level as multiple different ligands (CD137L, anti-CD3) were used.
